hooks.command:
FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path')

case "$FILE" in
  *.go)
    if gofmt -w "$FILE" && goimports -w "$FILE"; then
      jq -n --arg f "$FILE" '{message: ("Formatted: " + $f)}'
    else
      jq -n --arg f "$FILE" '{error: ("Format failed: " + $f)}'
    fi
    ;;
  *)
    jq -n '{}'
    ;;
esac
